Hold Shift while placing a piece to keep adding identical pieces.
With the board highlighted, you can move from square to square using the arrow keys.
With a highlighted square on the board, press the key corresponding to the piece to add it there (e.g. press "p" to add a black pawn, "Q" for a white queen, etc.).
Hold Shift while moving a piece to clone it instead of moving it.
You can now change the board colors in the configuration page.
You can now create a snapshot of the current position and restore it later.
If you paste (CTRL+V or CMD+V on Mac) a FEN with the board highlighted, it is applied to the board.
You can now access the problem editor directly from the menu without navigating through the problem list.
Open an SP3 database and use the Awards menu to create a verdict, compare problems side by side and assign prizes.
Award judgments are saved automatically: you can close the comparison dialog and resume it later.
Fairy piece effects are displayed alongside the moves in the solution list.
The solution tree you explore is saved in SP3 files and is restored when you reopen the database.
You can save the current database as an SP2 file with Save As in the web app.
In the desktop app you can browse your local drives and folders to open database files.
On desktop, set a custom Popeye executable path in Configuration under Solver Settings; leave it empty to use the bundled one.
Your preferences are stored with the operating system on desktop and in the browser on web.
